journey.title: Think First! 💭
journey.studentText: Which is bigger: 47 or 74? Look at the tens digit first. 7 tens is more than 4 tens, so 74 > 47.
journey.owlText: Take a moment to think about comparing and ordering. What do you already know? There's no wrong answer!
